title: Repository-wide logical identity audit
description: The result of 'vlab audit identity' (FR-ID-06). Answers three questions no single plan can, because each plan sees one reachable set: does any commit message claim more than one identity, do commits share a Change-Id without a recorded derivation between them, and does any applied commit have more than one claimed origin. Exits non-zero when errors are found.

scanned.description: The audit's scope: every commit reachable from any ref and every causal record in the notes ref, not one plan's reachable set. A collision a given plan cannot see is still a collision.

code.description: conflicting-change-id-trailer: one commit message carries several different Change-Id trailers, and planning reads only the first. change-id-collision: commits share a Change-Id across groups with no identity-preserving application record linking them, so the sharing is not the preserved identity of FR-ID-02. ambiguous-origin: one applied commit is claimed by application records naming different origins. fork-without-new-identity: a contextual-fork kept the origin Change-Id, which FR-ID-03 forbids. identity-not-preserved: a non-fork application changed the Change-Id, which FR-ID-02 forbids.

unlinkedGroups.description: The commit groups that carry the colliding Change-Id, partitioned by identity-preserving derivation. More than one group is what makes it a collision rather than a legitimately shared identity.
